record: LEAN Alpaca adapter MessagePack 3.1.9 security relock, native restore and build receipt
purpose: Clear GHSA-qhrr-8q5h-9q3h (CVE-2026-92707) from blueprints/us-equities/engine/patches/alpaca.packages.lock.json by raising the adapter's direct MessagePack reference from 3.1.7 to 3.1.9, its first patched 3.x release. The advisory was published 2026-10-15T18:35:46Z, after main's last passing osv-scanner run, and from then the required osv-scanner check failed on every run
authorization: Command-center incident brief for one trading-lane PR (2026-10-15): set the engine patch's MessagePack reference to 3.1.9, regenerate the Alpaca lock with dotnet restore in the engine build environment, keep LEAN Alpaca restoring for engine phase 2, and use an ignore entry only if the relock cannot build
